name: IIM Nagpur

about.text: Indian Institute of Management Nagpur was established in 2015, and initially, it was under the mentorship of IIM Ahmedabad. IIM Nagpur was shifted to a new and technically sound campus in 2015 at MIHAN, Nagpur, Maharashtra. IIM Nagpur Online is among the new generations of the IIMs and it is globally recognized as one of the most prominent management institutions worldwide.

IIM Nagpur Onlne has been known for its globally competent education system and its main aim is to create value-driven leaders, global managers, entrepreneurs, and industry-based leaders. The institute guides and upskills every individual at the institute to make them prominent in their relevant field, and all this happens with the support of the faculty with the well-maintained and revised curriculum of the programs.

IIM Nagpur Online offers various programs that include MBA, PhD, PhD Executive, and MBA Executive. Executive programs are among the new trends in the market and these programs are opted for by the working professional the main objective of these programs is to provide global exposure and approach to senior executives and give them an upgraded vision to monitor and lead their organization efficiently by enhancing their skills and acquiring knowledge with help of these programs.

emi.text: IIM Nagpur is among the most renowned institutes in India and is globally recognized for financially assisting students. The institute offers two major scholarships for the MBA (2 Years – Full Time) programme at IIM Nagpur:
IIM Nagpur Merit Scholarship – for the top ten scorer candidates securing 95%ile or above in CAT
IIM Nagpur Need-cum-Merit Scholarship – for candidates with family income less than Rs 8 lakhs

For blended MBA and other courses, students who are unable to pursue further studies due to financial constraints can opt for the education loan facility at any of the banks. The point to be noted here is that IIM Nagpur has no role to play in the process of availing this education loan facility. It is entirely dependent on your financial history and the bank.

admission.text: Students who are willing to get admission to the programs offered at IIM Nagpur Online are requested to appear and clear entrance exams relevant to the program they are opting such as GRE/GMAT/GATE/CAT and score marks according to the minimum criteria to compete with the shortlisted students, the admission process for regular program are conducted in 3 stages mentioned below:
Stage 1- A list is prepared of the shortlisted students based on the CAT cut-off, and eligible students can fill out the application form.
Stage 2- The institute selects candidates from the application forms for the next step, the Personal Interview (PI) based on the calculation of the Shortlisting Score.
Stage 3- This is the final stage where a candidate is selected based on the evaluation of the Final Score.

Meanwhile, candidates who are willing to enroll in the online and executive program offered at the university are required to follow some basic steps including an eligible score in the relevant entrance exam GRE/GMAT/GATE/CAT and there is a specific entrance exam conducted by the institute itself for executive programs. After qualifying for these exams, the candidate can move further with the admission process according to the eligibility criteria of their preferred program. The admission process is as follows:
Step 1- To get admission to the institute, candidates have to visit the official website of the institute and register themselves on the website to get access to the portal.
Step 2- After the registration process, the candidate will receive credentials to access the portal.

Step 3- After accessing the portal, candidates have to click on the application process tab and fill in their scores in the entrance exam if the scores are under the eligibility criteria only then the application process can be resumed.
Step 4- Right after filling in the scores, candidates have to fill out the application form with some basic questions and information.

Step 5- While filling out the details, the candidate has to attach the required documents along with the application form and make sure all the information and documents are accurate and valid or they will get rejected from the institution end.
Step 6- Go through the application form and recheck it, then pay the fee for the program opted.
Step 7- After payment of the fee candidate can finally submit the application form.

examination.text: The examination evaluation process of the Institute follows a basic pattern that includes two major components: internal assessment and term-end examinations. The internal assessment evaluates the practical understanding of an individual through quizzes, assignments, projects, etc., Whereas end-term examinations are conducted to evaluate the overall theoretical understanding of an individual and they carry 30% and 70% of overall weightage respectively.

placementText.text: The placement cell of the IIM Nagpur remains active throughout the year and assists full-time MBA students in every way possible through its Career Development Services (CDS). The placement cell helps students in developing industry-oriented skills and guides them to enhance their personality and abilities to compete with global competence. This support service is not available for the blended or hybrid MBA courses at IIM Nagpur. However, the name of the institution on your resume would attract some big firms and bring you to the notice of your dream company.
